# weller: replace the host key and rekey secrets (2026 rebuild)

weller was reinstalled today on new hardware (X870E / 9950X3D). Its new SSH host key is:

    ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAICaAqTE1kznlevOxLH6QuiMHI9UUKQj+OMIp2wkLWA0K root@weller

`secrets/keys.nix` still carries the DEAD weller host key from the pre-2026 install
(`weller = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGEqPYzGOvoeU3mpgBmw9XM/C3IaPETUBJeKtXsCBEBd";`).
That drive was wiped by disko; the old private key no longer exists anywhere.

## Do

1. In `secrets/keys.nix`, REPLACE the value of the `weller` host-key binding with the new key
   (public part only, no `root@weller` comment in the string — match the existing entries'
   format). Do not add a second entry; the old key is revoked by replacement. Leave the
   `patrick` user-key list untouched (its `# weller` entry is a separate question for the owner).
2. Rekey every secret so weller can decrypt them: from `secrets/`, run
   `nix run github:ryantm/agenix -- -r` (agenix is a flake input; the CLI can also come from the
   flake if a devShell exposes it — either is fine). This host's user key
   (`~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, the `# classic-laddie` entry in `patrick`) is a recipient of every
   secret, so rekeying works here without prompts. Every `*.age` file in `secrets/` must be
   rewritten. PASTE agenix's output in the report.
3. Sanity: `nix flake check` — PASTE the final lines. Also confirm, and paste, a decrypt test
   of one secret with the local identity (e.g. `nix run github:ryantm/agenix -- -d
   user-password.age > /dev/null && echo ok` from `secrets/`).

## Precedent

PR #235 "Add new SSH key for weller" and #236 "Add classic-laddie user SSH key and rekey
secrets" are the pattern: a one-line key change plus the rekeyed `.age` files in one PR.

## PR

Title: `secrets: replace weller's host key after the 2026 rebuild`. Body: the old→new key
fingerprints (`ssh-keygen -lf` on each), the list of rekeyed files, and one line noting the
stale `# weller` user key in `patrick` was deliberately left for the owner.

## Constraints

- Touch only `secrets/keys.nix` and the `secrets/*.age` files agenix rewrites.
- Never print or commit any decrypted secret content.
- Commit and push before long verification; never background a nix build and exit without
  committing.
